Second coverage layer for PLAN-027 W6 (FEAT-062). The DIRECTIVE coverage moat
(which macro forms the suite exercised) shipped. This adds JS LINE coverage mapped
back to .st source.

* Prerequisite (the real work)
There is currently NO source map from emitted JS byte-ranges -> .st SourceSpan.
=src/emit/sourcemap.rs= has SourceSpan types but emit does not produce a
=//# sourceMappingURL= / VLQ map. Without it, CDP =Profiler.takePreciseCoverage=
can only give JS-line coverage, not .st-line coverage.

* Tasks
1. Emit a source map: thread SourceSpan through the emit so each emitted JS range
   knows its originating .st file+line. Produce a standard source map (or an
   internal range->span table).
2. CDP integration (chromiumoxide_cdp has TakePreciseCoverage): Profiler.enable +
   startPreciseCoverage before the run, takePreciseCoverage after; collect per-script
   executed ranges.
3. Map executed JS ranges -> .st spans -> per-.st-file / per-primitive line coverage.
4. =--coverage= reports source % alongside directive %; optional lcov export.

* Why split from the W6 core
Directive coverage (the unique moat) needs only the macro registry + an expansion
sink (DONE, commit pending). JS->.st coverage needs source-map EMISSION
infrastructure that does not exist \u2014 a substantial, separable feature.
